name: Evaluate Matched DOM Fringe Excess

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Evaluate Matched DOM Fringe Excess

The acceptance criterion limits RayX chromatic-fringe energy relative to each matched DOM reference plus one 8-bit quantization unit, but the current target applies an unrelated absolute 0.02 limit even where the matched DOM control reaches approximately 0.88. Computing the maximum per-cell RayX-minus-DOM excess will implement the frozen requirement exactly without changing any pixels.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Add maximumFringeExcess to the current quality summary, compute it per matched cell, and gate it at 1/255. Preserve the absolute RayX value for diagnostics. Run the synthetic metric contracts and headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU matrix with unchanged production code; the 0.8046 acutance failure must remain red.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

The unchanged grayscale renderer still fails solely on minimum acutance, maximum fringe excess is zero or negative, and the target error reports both absolute RayX fringe and matched-reference excess. No baseline artifact or production source changes.

playwright: All eight synthetic metric tests passed.
The headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU matrix remained red on acutance with the expected predicate.
rayx: No production source or pixels changed. The current grayscale renderer supplied the control.
counters: Minimum acutance ratio remained 0.8046; absolute maximum RayX fringe ratio was 0; maximum matched-reference fringe excess was 0; maximum alignment delta was 2 physical pixels.

reportMarkdown:
## Experiment Report

The target now implements the requirement's per-cell matched-reference fringe excess and retains the absolute RayX fringe value for attribution. Unchanged grayscale output remains correctly red at 0.8046 acutance, with zero fringe excess and unchanged geometry. The measurement correction therefore does not weaken or manufacture the quality result.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Accept and commit the matched-fringe gate. Use it for the final composition-safe LCD candidate.
notes: The first wrapper invocation exceeded its command timeout while its owned child processes completed; a clean focused rerun produced the recorded result.
